svg.title: Fall Fairy Garden — step 2: Build a steady twig frame
svg.desc: Press four blunt forked twigs a short way into soft soil. Nest roof crosspieces in the forks, beside the rock or tree. Add a few side twigs, leaving a doorway. Keep it low and test that the pieces stay in place.

svg.text: Four forked twigs cradle the roof crosspieces.
